mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) by over 5% signals stronger consumer and business demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positively correlated with GDPC1's quarterly increase exceeding 5% (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: When the supply index (INDPRO) rises alongside a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), this dual trend signals accommodative monetary policy and robust production, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises 2% and FEDFUNDS falls 1% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positively correlated with the combined effect of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS changes (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in UNRATE (unemployment) above 6.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negatively correlated with UNRATE's monthly increase above 0.1% (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a monetary easing cycle, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% reduces discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary easing cycle, 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS < 2% (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarterly increase in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) by over 2% signals robust demand growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise > 2% in their respective periods (quarterly and monthly)
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positively correlated with both GDPC1 and RSAFS increases exceeding 2% (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A long-term upward trend in the supply index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening production capacity, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positively correlated with INDPRO's upward trend (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in monthly PAYEMS (employment) above 8 million signals a strengthening labor market, which may drive positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 8 million in a month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positively correlated with PAYEMS exceeding 8 million (p > 0.05 in t-test).
